blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings and tours featuring estate and reserve collections, attend concerts and workshops, join a wine club with seasonal shipments, and stay at a vineyard guest house with vineyard access and amenities. Wine tastings include flights of 3 to 5 wines with varying prices and experiences. The guest house offers a private stay with kitchen, pool, and vineyard views.
